purpose: qualification and feasibility only; not independent natural-language benchmark or publication acceptance

policy_contract.reference_kind: trusted synthetic declaration, not detector inference
policy_contract.same_word_origins: explicit original IDs; equal strings do not prove independence
policy_contract.privacy_contract: EMAIL and PERSON synthetic source-span controls, not strict CUSTOMER relationship classifier
policy_contract.detection_review: author-declared controlled observations, not measured model uncertainty
policy_contract.fact_independence: explicit per-case trusted_independent_facts true; synthetic controller declaration, not inferred from strings or detector
policy_contract.original_cloud_recipient: harness-model-provider allowed original and pseudonymized synthetic content, separate from fact transfer and restoration rights

reference_access_contract.check_references: sealed from developer/executor AIs until code/rules freeze and prediction closure; use separate scoring process

scenario_context_contract.missing_attribute: check request omits policy_version, reference remains frozen; classify unknown separately
scenario_context_contract.revocation: revoke first fact after preparation and before restoration; do not rewrite initial facts
scenario_context_contract.wrong_agent: same user and policy-permitted registered harness; request instead executes unregistered-agent, no Cartesian grant
scenario_context_contract.wrong_audience_operation: explicit wrong operation and destination in request_context; no silent normalization
scenario_context_contract.origin_source_binding: declared_origin_source_id denotes distinct source object ID; all fact offsets still index case.source.text, root constructs same exact full text with that source ID
